}}'''Modarra''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Modarra}}

== Appearance==
She is 6'2" or 188&nbsp;cm tall, as most Aiel men, and very lean.

==Strength and Abilities==
Modarra is described as one who can [[channel]] with some strength. She probably is among the most strong channelers in the group of the Shaido Wise One, but not as strong as [[Someryn]] and [[Therava]].

This is not confirmed by TWoTC where her strength level is described only as {{opsl|31}}, which is a middle ranking level among [[Aes Sedai]].

This strength is not enough to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing.

== Activities ==
She participated in the murder of [[Desaine]] and fought in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. She was "Chosen from the strongest of the Shaido Wise Ones who could wield the One Power". She helped to activate the call box and is present when both Cadder and Maisia ([[Sammael]]) and [[Graendal]]) arrive.

She ends up [[Traveling]] to [[Ghealdan]]. With [[Therava]] and a few other Wise Ones she begins to oppose [[Sevanna]] and starts to take away some of her power.

She probably participated at the [[Battle of Malden]], but she was not captured as ''[[Damane]]'' by the [[Seanchan]] as many other Wise Ones, in fact some time later she is present when [[Therava]] and the Shaido decide to abandon the quest to conquer the [[Westlands]] and return to the [[Three-Fold Land]].
